MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Year Zero feels worth trying because its abrasive industrial sound connects with the intensity I want from my heavier albums.",
    "Rock or Bust fits my interest in driving guitar riffs and hard rock energy, even though I often want something heavier."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Adele and Frankie Valli offer vocal-centered pop when I am looking for aggressive guitars and heavier vocals.",
    "ELO, Abbey Road, and Blackstar share a broad rock connection with my listening, but their melodic or experimental sounds do not satisfy my current desire for heaviness.",
    "Late Registration does not fit the guitar-driven listen I want, and I cannot identify Fm - Greatest Hits confidently enough to choose it."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The choices seem to treat a broad connection to rock as enough, although the weight and intensity of the music matter much more to me right now.",
    "The list feels too centered on widely familiar albums; familiarity alone does not make an album a natural follow-up to my recent listening."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated listening to albums such as Colony, Reroute to Remain, and Soundtrack to Your Escape suggests a sustained interest in heavier music that deserves more emphasis.",
    "My recent choices of Ten Thousand Fists and 10.000 Days reinforce my interest in forceful, guitar-driven music; I can consider different sounds when they preserve that intensity."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations caught some of my interest in forceful rock but mostly missed how strongly heaviness and guitar-driven intensity guide my choices right now."
}
